Les routes du goût : Emma and Alfonso's walk (1/2)

An intimate and gourmet meeting in the heart of Campania. Michelin-starred chef Alfonso Iaccarino opens the doors of Don Alfonso 1890, a temple of Mediterranean cuisine, where a family tradition spanning five generations continues. An opportunity to taste cuisine deeply rooted in terroir.
